propositions: A corrective coaching move should direct agents to re-derive incomplete source-code reference inventories using Serena symbol tools when a plan enumerates affected files by hand or incompletely
The criterion must route to plan_review only, not code_review, because code_review's overlay system uses a closed applies_when vocabulary that cannot include project.* criterion ids
The coaching move text must include both symbol-graph derivation via find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweep (monkeypatch.setattr/getattr/importlib) which LSP cannot resolve

The criterion posture must be advisory with default_posture: advisory and no blocking_enabled key, since plan_review's threshold_for does not read that field and coaching a method must not gate process
The overlay requires three new configuration files: criteria_routing.json entry, a prompt markdown file, and a plan_review_moves.json entry following the existing project.portability pattern exactly

Live runs demonstrate the criterion fires reliably at validity 1.0 on hand-enumerated plans naming omitted sites including string-literal references, but the coaching move cannot reliably reach agent selection because incomplete inventory also fires blocking built-ins G1G2/G6/E4 which coach first
